snippet.title: Vagrus - The Riven Realms: At the Heart of Ruin | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
After over a year of development, Lost Pilgrims Studio, creators of Vagrus - the Riven Realms, have released their most ambitious DLC yet: At the Heart of Ruin. The expansion became available on the 22nd of October on all platforms except Nintendo, due to a longer approval process. Alongside it, they released the Ruinous Supporter Pack, which gives those who wish to support the studio an opportunity to do so while receiving a new cosmetics outfit for each of the game’s companion characters.

PressKit: http://vagrus.com/press/

   - Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672540/Vagrus__The_Riven_Realms_At_the_Heart_of_Ruin/
